question: Why can whatever is pleasing and fit for worship serve as a cause in both liberation and attainment?
premises: The same cause can operate in both liberation and attainment.
Whatever is pleasing to the mind and fit for worship may be chosen.
Its effectiveness depends on completeness joined with the force of necessity.
inference: Although the chosen object may vary, its causal power in both aims comes from the completeness of conditions grounded in necessity.
uncertainties: The compressed compound niyatiprāṇatāyogātsāmagrītastu allows more than one syntactic unpacking.
plain_english: In both liberation and attainment, whatever is pleasing to the mind and fit for worship can be the cause, because its effectiveness comes from the completeness of conditions operating through necessity.
